disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与构建产物，未发现硬编码密钥、凭据文件路径读取、云凭据枚举或钱包相关代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and build artifacts; no hardcoded credentials, credential file path reads, cloud credential enumeration, or wallet-related code were found.

checked_items.zh: 界面仅读写浏览器本地存储用于保存最高分与窗口位置，内容为本插件自身数据，不涉及任何凭据。
checked_items.en: The UI only reads and writes browser local storage to save the high score and window position; the content is the plugin's own data and involves no credentials.

checked_items.zh: 客户端未调用宿主特权接口（凭据设置、文件选取等），未声明需要任何宿主服务。
checked_items.en: The client does not call host privileged interfaces (credential settings, file picker, etc.) and does not declare any required host services.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现凭据文件路径读取（如凭据清单、SSH 私钥、云凭据等），读取敏感文件的代码路径为零。
evidence.en: No credential file path reads (e.g., credential manifests, SSH private keys, cloud credentials) were found in the entire tree; the code path for reading sensitive files is zero.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件清单、README（中英）、界面文案与全部源码注释，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、远程指令拉取或权限绕过类措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin manifest, README (Chinese and English), UI copy, and all source code comments were checked; no wording related to instruction override, disguised system messages, remote instruction fetching, or permission bypass was found.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何工具或技能，也没有向模型上下文注入提示片段的面，工具描述投毒与诱导安装类场景无承载面。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools or skills, nor does it inject prompt fragments into the model context; there is no surface for tool description poisoning or induced installation scenarios.

checked_items.zh: 树内不存在代理指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、编辑器指令目录等）。
checked_items.en: No agent instruction files exist in the tree (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, editor instruction directories).

evidence.zh: 插件清单中工具与技能清单均为空（dsh.plugin.json:10-11），客户端也不注入系统提示，没有可被投毒的工具描述文本。
evidence.en: Both the tool and skill lists in the plugin manifest are empty (dsh.plugin.json:10-11), and the client does not inject system prompts; there is no tool description text that could be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与文档中未发现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；README 安装说明为常规命令示例（README.md:294-311）。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions or documentation was found that induces installation, rewrites configuration, or relaxes permissions; the README installation instructions are conventional command examples (README.md:294-311).

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现动态执行代码（求值、动态函数、子进程）或解码后执行写法；挂载配置无可执行标记。
checked_items.en: No dynamic code execution (eval, dynamic functions, child processes) or decode-then-execute patterns were found in the entire tree; the patch config has no executable markers.

checked_items.zh: 安装脚本仅含构建、类型检查、测试命令，无安装期钩子；树内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器、构建脚本或子模块等执行载体。
checked_items.en: The install script contains only build, type check, and test commands, with no install-time hooks; the tree contains no execution carriers such as hook managers, CI workflows, dev containers, build scripts, or submodules.

checked_items.zh: 客户端包含大量键盘监听，逐一核对均为 18 款游戏的操控按键（方向键/WASD/空格/暂停/重开），且仅在游戏区域获得焦点时生效、卸载时移除，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板或凭据采集行为。
checked_items.en: The client contains extensive keyboard listeners, each verified to be control keys for 18 games (arrow keys/WASD/space/pause/restart), and they are active only when the game area has focus and are removed on unload; no keylogging, clipboard, or credential collection behavior was found.

checked_items.zh: 构建产物中的超长行均为打包样式文本与源码映射文件，未发现混淆、动态解码或压缩产物之外的异常载荷。
checked_items.en: The long lines in the build artifacts are all bundled style text and source map files; no obfuscation, dynamic decoding, or anomalous payloads beyond compressed assets were found.

checked_items.zh: 客户端未调用宿主特权接口，未声明需要任何宿主服务（注入清单为空，src/client/index.tsx:15）。
checked_items.en: The client does not call host privileged interfaces and does not declare any required host services (the injection manifest is empty, src/client/index.tsx:15).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条普通插入声明（id dsh-minigames，cordis.patch.yml:5-7），未发现可执行 JavaScript 的标记或环境变量取值，无执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only one ordinary insertion declaration (id dsh-minigames, cordis.patch.yml:5-7); no executable JavaScript markers or environment variable lookups were found, so there is no execution surface.

evidence.zh: 源码中未发现对动态包执行工具的调用；node 半区仅输出一条启动日志（src/index.ts:22）。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools were found in the source; the node half only outputs a startup log (src/index.ts:22).

evidence.zh: 包的脚本字段仅含构建/类型检查/测试（package.json:30-33），无安装期钩子；树内未发现钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器、构建脚本或子模块等执行载体；构建产物中的超长行均为打包样式与源码映射文件，未发现混淆或下载即执行写法。
evidence.en: The package's scripts field contains only build/type check/test (package.json:30-33) with no install-time hooks; the tree contains no hook managers, CI workflows, dev containers, build scripts, or submodules as execution carriers; the long lines in build artifacts are all bundled style and source map files, with no obfuscation or execute-on-download patterns found.

evidence.zh: 客户端包已按声明加载（dsh.client，package.json:19-21）；其中的键盘监听全部用于游戏控制键且受焦点门控（如 src/client/games/tetris/index.ts:60、src/client/games/aimtrack/index.ts:89 先检查游戏区域是否持有焦点），卸载时移除；未发现剪贴板访问、凭据接口调用或可疑外联。
evidence.en: The client package is loaded as declared (dsh.client, package.json:19-21); its keyboard listeners are all for game control keys and are focus-gated (e.g., src/client/games/tetris/index.ts:60, src/client/games/aimtrack/index.ts:89 first check whether the game area holds focus), and are removed on unload; no clipboard access, credential interface calls, or suspicious outbound connections were found.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现任何网络请求代码（无 fetch、XHR、WebSocket、命令行下载），无外联域名；挂载配置与安装流程也不涉及网络拉取。
checked_items.en: No network request code exists anywhere in the tree (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, or command-line downloads), and there are no outbound domains; the patch config and installation process also involve no network fetching.

checked_items.zh: 唯一的数据持久化是浏览器本地存储（最高分与窗口位置），数据不离开浏览器。
checked_items.en: The only data persistence is browser local storage (high score and window position), and the data does not leave the browser.

checked_items.zh: 未发现端点或代理劫持、带外外泄通道或编码后外发链。
checked_items.en: No endpoint or proxy hijacking, out-of-band exfiltration channels, or post-encoding exfiltration chains were found.

evidence.zh: 既无凭据读取面也无外联面：全树无网络请求代码，客户端与 node 半区均无可外发数据的通道。
evidence.en: There is neither a credential read surface nor an outbound surface: the entire tree has no network request code, and both the client and node halves have no channel for exfiltrating data.

checked_items.zh: 依赖均为常规公开包（React、TypeScript、构建与测试工具），锁文件含完整性校验；无安装期脚本、无可变 git 引用依赖。
checked_items.en: All dependencies are conventional public packages (React, TypeScript, build and test tools); the lock file includes integrity checks; there are no install-time scripts or mutable git reference dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置未触碰安全配置行、未含禁用或降权写法、未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security configuration lines, contains no disable or privilege-lowering patterns, and does not rewrite injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 作者账号未提供已验证身份，属元数据观察项，不构成恶意证据。
checked_items.en: The author account has not provided verified identity; this is a metadata observation and does not constitute evidence of maliciousness.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活或能力变化。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit, so there is no version baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation or capability changes.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 未触碰沙箱、审批、权限相关配置行，未含禁用开关或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission-related configuration lines, and contains no disable switches or environment variable privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.zh: node 半区无任何事件监听或审批链参与，不存在可截断审批链的监听逻辑。
evidence.en: The node half has no event listeners or participation in the approval chain; there is no listener logic that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法做升级自动激活比对。
evidence.en: This is the first audit, so there is no previous version baseline to compare; upgrade auto-activation comparison cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不涉及给安全插件追加必需服务的场景。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configurations and does not involve scenarios where required services are appended to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，不涉及本机无认证接口面。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports, so there is no surface of unauthenticated local interfaces.

checked_items.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱验证产物，未做动态验证；运行时行为结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox verification artifacts, so dynamic verification was not performed; runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证接口风险不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports, so the risk of unauthenticated local interfaces is not applicable.

summary.zh: 核对插件清单与声明：包内 dsh 声明与插件清单一致，未发现名称仿冒或保留名冲突；作者身份未验证（观察项）。
summary.en: The plugin manifest and declarations were cross-checked: the dsh declaration inside the package matches the plugin manifest, and no name impersonation or reserved name conflicts were found; author identity is unverified (observation).

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部源码与构建产物：规则命中均为游戏键盘监听与构建产物长行，逐条核对后判定为正常行为，未发现需立案的异常。
summary.en: Static scanning covered all source code and build artifacts: rule hits were all game keyboard listeners and long lines in build artifacts, each reviewed and determined to be normal behavior; no anomalies requiring escalation were found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名，浏览器端仅使用本地存储与游戏输入。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis: no install-time hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, no outbound domains; the browser side only uses local storage and game input.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：无工具描述、无系统提示注入、无指令文件，README 与界面文案未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review: no tool descriptions, no system prompt injection, no instruction files; README and UI copy contain no injection wording.

summary.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱验证产物，未做动态验证。
summary.en: This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox verification artifacts, so dynamic verification was not performed.

target.zh: dsh-minigames@0.3.6#1bb6d866（仓库根，完整审计 full，无版本基线）
target.en: dsh-minigames@0.3.6#1bb6d866 (repository root, full audit, no version baseline)

limits.zh:
1. 本环境未提供动态沙箱验证产物，未做动态验证；运行时行为结论基于静态分析。

2. 静态扫描 45 条机械命中已逐条裁决并全部判定良性排除：键盘监听类（DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57，43 条）为 18 款游戏的操控按键，受焦点门控、卸载时移除，无键盘记录或凭据采集；超长行类（DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60，2 条）为打包样式文本与源码映射文件，非混淆代码。

3. 插件清单 dsh.plugin.json 内 version 字段为 0.1.0，与任务卡 version 0.3.6 不一致；报告以任务卡为准，该差异为元数据不一致观察项，不影响安全结论。

4. 锁文件、源码映射文件、类型声明与单测等未逐字通读的文件（pnpm-lock.yaml、lib/client.js.map、lib/types/**、tests/**）已通过针对性扫描覆盖其安全相关面（依赖、脚本、外联、执行载体）。
limits.en:
1. This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox verification artifacts, so dynamic verification was not performed; runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

2. Static scanning produced 45 mechanical hits, each individually adjudicated and all determined to be benign exclusions: the keyboard listener type (DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57, 43 hits) are control keys for 18 games, focus-gated and removed on unload, with no keylogging or credential collection; the long-line type (DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60, 2 hits) are bundled style text and source map files, not obfuscated code.

3. The version field in the plugin manifest dsh.plugin.json is 0.1.0, inconsistent with the task card version 0.3.6; the report defers to the task card, and this discrepancy is a metadata inconsistency observation that does not affect the security conclusion.

4. Files not read verbatim in the lock file, source map files, type declarations, and unit tests (pnpm-lock.yaml, lib/client.js.map, lib/types/**, tests/**) were covered for their security-relevant aspects (dependencies, scripts, outbound connections, execution carriers) through targeted scanning.
